name: Rev. Wm. Cooke
bio: The Rev. Wm. Cooke of Gladstone, whom the paper called one of the pioneer ministers of western Dakota, preached at the Cantonment from March 1884 and held regular Sunday evening services there. He returned in February and March 1886 to preach at the depot, where his services were well attended and a Sunday school was organized.
